properties.nt: Roman-held Nile reach from Aswan to Hiera Sycaminos (Muharraqa). After the treaty of Samos "In −21 or −20", "the frontier between the Roman and Meroitic empires was fixed at Hiera Sycaminos (Muharraqa)" (GHA II p.290); the province "called the Dodecaschene ... about 120 kilometres from Syene (Aswan) to Hiera Sycaminos (Muharraqa)" (p.208). Diocletian (284–305) "gave up Nubia" (p.215), "towards the end of the third century" pulling the frontier back to the First Cataract (p.294); the shape ends at his accession because the sources give no exact year. Only the Nile valley between the named places is drawn; the width of the band is not from the source.
properties.nta: الامتداد الروماني على النيل من أسوان حتى هيرا سيكامينوس (المحرّقة) بعد معاهدة ساموس وحتى تخلّي دقلديانوس عن النوبة، وفق المصدر المذكور؛ عرض الشريط غير مأخوذ من المصدر.
